rubric_items.reason: REQ-1 to REQ-11, including assumed REQ-11, are each traced by exactly one story: S-1 (REQ-1 to 5), S-2 (REQ-6, 7) and S-3 (REQ-8 to 11).
Each story has one outcome. S-2 may grow if U-3 resolves to adding new doctor/day filters to the appointment list, and that is not shown as separate scope.
All criteria use Given/When/Then. S-1 AC4 asserts an internal 'same counting rule', which cannot be observed. S-3 AC3/AC4 do not name the filters or search they check.
Every value (Today, Asia/Kolkata, 0, 20 per page, sort by name, the column list, Cancelled) comes from req.md.
Readable and consistent overall. The body ACs are shorter than the front-matter ACs and lose detail, e.g. Asia/Kolkata drops out of S-1 AC3.

findings.text: S-1 AC4 says both computations 'use the same counting rule'. That describes the implementation and cannot be checked from outside. Testers need an outcome they can compare, such as matching numbers.

cites.quote: then both use the same counting rule.

findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite as: given the same appointments for today, the sum of Today counts across all doctors equals the dashboard 'Appointments today' tile value.

findings.text: S-3 AC3/AC4 refer to 'the list's current filters' and 'current search' without naming them. That makes the regression check open-ended.

cites.quote: Given staff apply the list's current filters, when the list reloads, then the same doctors are shown as before this change.

findings.suggested_fix: Name the existing filters and search fields of the doctors list, or link to their spec (PRD DOC-2).

findings.text: U-6 says S-2 has no criterion for a 0 count. But S-2 AC1 covers any Today count, which includes 0, so it already implies 0 links.

cites.quote: S-2 has no criterion for 0 until answered.
Given the doctors list shows a Today count for a doctor, when staff select the count

findings.suggested_fix: Either limit S-2 ACs to non-zero counts until Q-06 is answered, or state that the Q-06 default (every count links) applies.

findings.text: The body ACs differ from the front-matter ACs. Body S-1 AC3 drops 'Asia/Kolkata', and body S-3 AC3 changes the When clause to 'when applied'.

cites.quote: Given today's appointments in several statuses including Cancelled, when the list loads
Given a doctor has appointments starting today in Asia/Kolkata in several statuses including Cancelled

findings.suggested_fix: Render the body ACs verbatim from the front matter.
